title: Lee
description: Kwena, Khudu, Nonyane ya Lewatle le Kgogo ba fitlhela lee. A ke lee la rona? ‘Lee la rona,’ go bua mme le rre ba ba motlotlo. Batlisisa gore ke lee la ga mang.
